question: Can compulsory longest matching with immediate persistent phrase learning represent the already retained strict internal whole-group triples?
decision_note: HAND_WRITER_RECONSTRUCTION_20261004.md: 6 October bounded growing-phrase hand-rule proof review
validation: Root read the complete producer note, independently derived both finite-string arguments, checked the aab/aaa hand cases and read857 REPORT in full. No executable corpus experiment, source cipher or new native query.
carrier_contract: One complete A-record or B-index per whole written group; fixed injective labels and immutable dictionary expansions during an epoch. No internal physical-line resets or hidden source-word flushes. No atomization, glyph values or English meanings are assumed.

A.rule: Longest known u plus exactly one next source character c is one regular record (index(u),c); immediately add u+c. A terminal no-c record is distinctly tagged.
A.proof: After one (i,c), its immutable u+c persists. Any later identical regular record would choose u while the strictly longer u+c matches. This contradicts maximality, including when u+c is the entire remainder (which requires its terminal record).
A.bound: No repeated regular record anywhere in the epoch. The separately tagged sole terminal record cannot duplicate a regular one.
A.application: Each old triple contains an immediate equal pair and is internal to one physical line, so the contract is contradicted without allocating any carrier.

B.rule: Output the stable index of longest known nonempty w; if source remains, add w+c for its next character before selecting the next phrase.
B.proof: Three equal indices would expand to www. After the first w, w+first(w) has been added. It matches the start of the remainder ww before the second choice and is strictly longer than w, a contradiction.
B.bound: No three immediately equal index groups in one epoch. Doubles are permitted.
B.double_countercheck: Initial entries a,b; source aab gives a,a,b. After the first a, aa exists but does not match the remaining ab.
B.positive_readback_corner_case: Source aaa gives a,aa. At decode, the next undefined index has expansion previous+first(previous)=aa; this case is included in the producer contract.
B.application: Each of the four already recorded all-reader strict triple coordinates directly contradicts this fixed contract.

native_evidence_limit: Existing857 transcriptions only. Both internal and exterior seams are definite; all three copies lie inside one line. Three readings observe the same manuscript and are not independent replications. No ink adjudication, new count, source identity or native meaning.
retained_predecessors: 857 excludes its nonsingleton cyclic-pool subclass; it did not test these online dictionaries.1179C uses token distances and paired short source words.1181/1188 have frozen source-trained phrase books.940 has recency slots with presegmented fragments. Their original decisions stay unchanged. No exhaustive novelty claim.
outside_scope: Finite dictionary without learning or saturation-induced learning stop
Delayed admission after the next phrase
Unmarked source-word flushes or within-line resets
Multiple records per group, or split records
Transcription errors admitted into the mechanism
research_consequence: Do not implement a22-sign writer or a new source/statistical run for these fixed contracts. They cannot satisfy the known within-line repetitions. This is a new scoped deduction from old evidence, not new manuscript data or decipherment progress.
not_concluded: No general rejection of shorthand, dictionaries, compression, natural language or human authorship. No native alphabet, translated word, allograph identity or historically used algorithm.
reopening: A genuinely different complete contract with a separate motivated falsifier may be reviewed. The failed rules are not repaired here with discretionary exceptions, reset placement or changed addresses.
